parameters.query:
WITH auth_update AS (
  UPDATE context_api_keys SET last_used_at = now()
  WHERE key_hash = encode(digest('{{ $json.apiKey }}', 'sha256'), 'hex') AND active = true
  RETURNING id, home_scope, allowed_scopes
)
SELECT COALESCE(
  (SELECT home_scope FROM auth_update LIMIT 1),
  '__UNAUTHORIZED__'
) AS home_scope,
COALESCE(
  (SELECT allowed_scopes FROM auth_update LIMIT 1),
  '{}'::text[]
) AS allowed_scopes,
(SELECT id FROM auth_update LIMIT 1) AS api_key_id

={{ 'SELECT id, title, category FROM context_blocks WHERE content_hash = encode(digest(' + $('Build Upsert').item.json.content_raw + ', \'sha256\'), \'hex\') AND NOT is_archived AND scope = ' + $('Build Upsert').item.json.scope_raw + ' AND category = ' + $('Build Upsert').item.json.category_raw + ' AND title = ' + $('Build Upsert').item.json.title_raw + ' LIMIT 1' }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ success: true, action: 'noop', reason: 'identical_content', existing_id: $json.id }) }}

parameters.query: ={{ 'UPDATE context_blocks SET embedding = \'' + JSON.stringify($json.embeddings[0]) + '\' WHERE id = \'' + $('Execute Upsert').item.json.id + '\'' }}

SELECT count(*) AS write_count FROM context_access_log
WHERE api_key_id = '{{ $('Auth Lookup').item.json.api_key_id }}'::uuid
  AND action = 'write'
  AND created_at > now() - INTERVAL '60 seconds'

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ success: false, error: 'Rate limit exceeded: max 100 writes per 60 seconds' }) }}
